name: plan-not-the-approver
about: Planning scenario 6 (docs/phases/07-planning.md): someone other than the approver posts an idea in #plan and replies in a plan's thread. Nothing starts, the bot says nothing (no reply, no ephemeral; loopd logs it), and their reply does not reach the agent. The approver's own message in #plan does start a plan, so the silence is the rule and not a deaf bot.
